title: Prefill: KDA chain (core + conv + gated o_norm)
shape: DEP16 F16K (3 x 5,461 tok) at L78K, NVFP4 config (KDA in/o_proj MXFP8 -> o_norm writes the MXFP8 o_proj input), 96 KDA heads at TP1, FP32 state; per GPU per prefill forward, 69 KDA layers
basis: MEASURED microbench on 1 VR200 GPU at the deployed per-GPU shape, NVFP4 config (benchmarks/kimi_k3/bench_kda_prefill_chain.py, CUPTI kernel sums x 69): baseline 1118 us/layer, current 1054 us/layer (ab14); model nvfp4_modelopt|P3-16|prefill conv 55.1 + gate_beta_norm 18.4 + core_prefill 167.0 + o_norm 12.2 = 252.7 us/layer
gap_analysis: Per layer at F16K: K2 394 + K1 299 + conv 220 + o_norm 139 = 1054 us (72.7 ms/forward) vs model 253 us (17.4 ms). MEASURED (sc1): K2 is SM-throughput bound on the 76 SMs that hold 2 of the 288 (seq, head) items (~1300 clk per item-step, mma.sync tensor floor 832); a lone chain is 0.52 us/step. Even perfectly balanced, an mma.sync recurrence has a tensor floor of 288 x 341 x 832 clk / 212 SMs = 169 us (= the whole model core row), so the SOL recurrence must run on tcgen05 (4x rate). Bytes: K1 writes a 1.34 GB workspace and K2 reads 1.73 GB (+ conv pass 2.4 GB + o_norm pass ~1 GB); the hardware-limited design reads only raw q|k|v, g, beta and writes MXFP8 o once (~2.2 GB ~ 180 us at 12.3 TB/s). SIMT: conv 98K FMA + ~24K exp per 64-token item-step; at 1.36 items/SM ~130 us if spread over all SMs - under the HBM time.
inefficiencies: MEASURED: recurrence latency-bound: 1.16 us per chunk step (stock mma.sync); tcgen05 step 2.0 us+ (dependent K=16 accumulation chain, blocking MMA issue, ~300-350 clk per tensor-core hand-off)
MEASURED: K1 prepare 299 us: 98K single-shot CTAs; when co-resident with K2 it slows K2 (latency-bound) -> needs a persistent low-occupancy pipelined K1
MEASURED: in-tree full-width K2 was 1 block/SM (ExactState state_lo smem) -> 2 waves; fixed (aa0753e84d)
MEASURED: conv pass 220 us at HBM rate; o_norm 139 us (floor ~85)
rubin_features: bulk tensor copies (TMA) for the FusedConv raw Q|K|V boxes (exp branch)
packed FP32 FMA/mul/add (fma.rn.f32x2) in the conv + SiLU (IEEE per lane)

planned: tcgen05 MMA with the FP32 state as a TMEM accumulator (kind::f16 BF16 operands, stock FlashKDA chunk-16 math) for the 96-head recurrence; persistent TMA-ring K1; larger per-SM shared memory for multi-tile K1 rings
plan: DONE (landed-ready 47bc2f317f): HBM-rate gated o_norm + MXFP8 kernel: -59 us/layer F16K

SOL DESIGN (projected ~185-200 us/layer vs model 253; bound = HBM 2.2 GB): one persistent fused kernel per KDA layer, 2 items per SM (256 TMEM cols each): producer warps load raw q|k|v rows + g + beta by TMA, apply conv/L2norm/gate/cumsum/decay in smem and build the chunk-64 intra matrices (INV64 from 16x16 blocks, Mqk64) on tcgen05; math warps run the chunk-64 recurrence on tcgen05 (V on M, fp32 state row per thread in registers, bf16 S^T as A operand; MMA1 [kd|qd] M128 N128 K128, MMA2 INV M128 N64 K64, MMA3 kr^T@U M128 N128 K64 + Mqk@U), 86 chain steps per item instead of 341; epilogue gated o_norm + MXFP8.

Step 1 (now): measure FLA's chunk-64 Triton chain on VR200 at F16K (evidence for chunk-64 chain time), then a standalone chunk-64 tcgen05 recurrence microbench fed by a torch-built chunk-64 workspace: target <= 100 us at 288 items (vs 394)
Step 2: in-kernel chunk-64 producer (conv + norm + gate + intra) replacing K1 + the conv pass (removes ~3 GB of HBM traffic)
Step 3: o_norm + MXFP8 epilogue; in-step A/B with step_p.sh -q nvfp4
